<function name="SetFrags" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets a player's frags (kills)</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="fragCount" type="number">Number of frags (positive or negative)</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Sets the frags of player 1 to 9001</description>
	<code>Entity( 1 ):SetFrags( 9001 )</code>

</example>
